headline.purpose: Ordinary page headings; post titles have a responsive override.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Link color/decoration, skip-link position, and footer opacity. Reduced-motion styles disable link and skip-link transitions.

components.name: Text link
components.description: Underlined blue text with an offset keyboard outline.
components.css: .ds-text { font-family: var(--font-serif, "Vollkorn", Georgia, "Times New Roman", Times, serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-link { color: var(--color-link, #0066cc); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .15em; text-decoration-thickness: .06em; transition: color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease), text-decoration-color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease); } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--color-link-hover, #004d99); text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-link:visited { color: var(--color-link, #0066cc); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0066cc); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Filesystem breadcrumb
components.description: Inner-page navigation pairs a serif home link with a monospace path.
components.html: George Anagnostou~/writing/genesis
components.css: .ds-crumb { padding: var(--space-4, 1rem) var(--space-6, 1.5rem); background: var(--color-bg, #f5f5f5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #eeeeee); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.4; word-break: break-word; } .ds-crumb-home { font-family: var(--font-serif, "Vollkorn", Georgia, "Times New Roman", Times, serif); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-accent, #0066cc); text-decoration: none; } .ds-crumb-home:hover { color: var(--color-link-hover, #004d99); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-crumb-path { margin-left: .25em; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Consolas", "Monaco", "Courier New", monospace); font-size: .95em; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #666666); } .ds-crumb-path code { font-family: inherit; color: var(--color-accent, #0066cc); } .ds-crumb-parent { color: var(--color-text-secondary, #666666); text-decoration: none; } .ds-crumb-parent:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #0066cc); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-crumb a { text-underline-offset: .15em; transition: color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease), text-decoration-color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease); } .ds-crumb a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0066cc); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-crumb a { transition: none; } }

components.name: Personal directory row
components.description: One link spans a destination name and its supporting description.
components.html: AboutThe longer introduction.
components.css: .ds-directory { color: var(--color-link, #0066cc); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .15em; text-decoration-thickness: .06em; transition: color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease), text-decoration-color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease); } .ds-directory:hover { color: var(--color-link-hover, #004d99); text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-directory:visited { color: var(--color-link, #0066cc); } .ds-directory:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0066cc); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-directory { transition: none; } } .ds-directory { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: baseline; gap: var(--space-1, .25rem) var(--space-4, 1rem); padding: var(--space-3, .75rem) 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dddddd); font-family: var(--font-serif, "Vollkorn", Georgia, "Times New Roman", Times, serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; text-decoration: none; } .ds-directory:hover { text-decoration: none; } .ds-directory-name { font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .15em; } .ds-directory-description { color: var(--color-text-secondary, #666666); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-directory:hover .ds-directory-name, .ds-directory:focus-visible .ds-directory-name { text-decoration-thickness: .12em; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-directory { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }

components.name: Writing row
components.description: A date column, wrapping title, and italic description form a shared reading-list pattern.
components.html: 2026-09-26Post titleA short description of the post.
components.css: .ds-writing-title { color: var(--color-link, #0066cc); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .15em; text-decoration-thickness: .06em; transition: color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease), text-decoration-color var(--transition-fast, .15s ease); } .ds-writing-title:hover { color: var(--color-link-hover, #004d99); text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-writing-title:visited { color: var(--color-link, #0066cc); } .ds-writing-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0066cc); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-writing-title { transition: none; } } .ds-writing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6rem minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "date title" ". description"; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--space-1, .25rem) var(--space-8, 2rem); padding: var(--space-2, .5rem) 0; font-family: var(--font-serif, "Vollkorn", Georgia, "Times New Roman", Times, serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-writing-date { grid-area: date; color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b6b6b); font-size: .85rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-writing-title { grid-area: title; color: var(--color-text, #333333); font-weight: 600; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-writing-title:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #0066cc); } .ds-writing-description { grid-area: description; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #666666); font-size: .92rem; font-style: italic; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-writing { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "date" "title" "description"; } }

components.name: Project terminal
components.description: A horizontally scrollable, focusable code surface.
components.html: bun run build
components.css: .ds-terminal { margin: 0; padding: var(--space-4, 1rem); background: var(--color-pre-bg, #1e1e1e); color: var(--color-pre-text, #e8e8e8); border-radius: var(--media-radius, 4px); font-family: var(--font-mono, "Consolas", "Monaco", "Courier New", monospace); font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.6; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre; } .ds-terminal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0066cc); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Keep the site light, curious, and approachable. The incumbent identity uses serif reading text, familiar blue links, a quiet gray background, and a narrow column. Personality comes through writing, real photographs, project evidence, and the small shrimp footer.

This document records the implemented visual system. Page strategy belongs in `PRODUCT.md` and the surface briefs; CSS in `src/static/css/` supplies the implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Serif reading text with restrained sans-serif metadata and monospace technical details.
Open sections separated by space and fine rules.
Visible links, keyboard focus, and wrapping content on small screens.
dos: Do preserve the serif, blue-link, narrow-column identity.
Do use spacing and fine rules to organize open reading sections.
Do retain visible link cues, keyboard outlines, and responsive wrapping.
Do use existing tokens and modular component or page styles.
donts: Don't replace the reading column with a dashboard or promotional card grid.
Don't add shadows, decorative gradients, or new accent colors without an intentional visual-system change.
Don't hide supplied captions or nest interactive controls inside directory links.
